response.description: An architecture-aware diagnostic adapter for Self-EvolveRec that inspects the trained recommender using measured signals and explicitly defined metrics. It preserves DiagnosisProbe(view, device), run_full_diagnosis(train_loader), and diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis). Model selection uses macro-average validation HR@10 across Movies_and_TV, Industrial_and_Scientific, Electronics, and CDs_and_Vinyl.
response.motivation: Support evidence-based recommender improvements while keeping diagnostics compatible with the benchmark and preventing interpretations based on unavailable reviews, product attributes, or simulator traits.
response.implementation_notes: Use view.model as the actual trained nn.Module and the compatibility methods for embeddings, sequence features, and item scoring. Adapt probes when the architecture changes. Process batches of (None, sequence, positive, negative), with tensors shaped B × L. Return measured metrics and metric_definitions; explicitly mark unsupported or unobserved signals rather than inventing values. Available evidence is limited to public interaction histories, item titles, descriptions, and timestamps. Generate full-catalog unseen-item recommendations for twenty real training users, five per category. Preserve category routing, fixed splits, preprocessing seed 0, training seed 42, and the pinned validation protocol. Keep test information outside diagnosis and selection.
response.pseudocode:
class DiagnosisProbe:
    init(view, device):
        store view and device

    run_full_diagnosis(train_loader):
        preserve model training state
        set view.model to evaluation mode
        with gradients disabled:
            collect supported measurements from batches
            inspect actual model parameters and representations
            generate unseen-item recommendations for designated training users
        restore model training state
        return {metrics: measured_values, metric_definitions: explicit_definitions}

function diagnosis_interpreter_prompt(raw_diagnosis):
    include measured metrics and their definitions
    state unavailable evidence and interpretation limits
    request evidence-grounded findings and actionable hypotheses
    prohibit invented attributes, traits, and test-based conclusions

originality.positive: Combines architecture-aware diagnostics with an explicit evidence contract and benchmark-aligned selection.
originality.negative: Primarily an integration specification; no new diagnostic estimator or learning algorithm is described. Score uses a 1–10 scale.

future_potential.positive: Could support systematic diagnosis, controlled architecture comparisons, and iterative improvements under a shared validation objective.
future_potential.negative: Diagnostic usefulness and gains remain un demonstrated; limited observable data restricts behavioral explanations. Score uses a 1–10 scale.

code_difficulty.positive: Stable interfaces and explicit batch shapes make the adapter straightforward to integrate.
code_difficulty.negative: Reliable architecture-specific measurements, full-catalog recommendation generation, and careful interpretation require additional implementation work. Score uses a 1–10 scale, with higher values indicating greater difficulty.
